name: ECG-derived respiration (EDR) as a secondary reference candidate
rationale: EDR can sometimes infer respiration from ECG morphology/timing, but it is NOT equivalent to a direct respiratory_belt_or_capnography reference. It introduces new degrees of freedom (lead/channel selection, amplitude vs RSA methods, filtering/windowing, beat detection, interpolation, phase/delay, artefact rejection, subject/posture dependence).

governance.must_never_change_primary_verdict: The Mendeley EXT-RR-MULTI-001 REFERENCE_UNUSABLE verdict is immutable.

validation_plan: Validate EDR-derived respiratory rate against a synchronized direct respiratory belt/RIP/capnography reference on an independent dataset; freeze the extraction protocol; only then permit a separate secondary-analysis claim on cardiac-reference datasets.
